before: Formatting at a caret inside a word armed a local typing format, and a format painter click split a word at hidden tracked deletion text.
after: Formatting at a caret inside a word writes the whole word through the existing setRunProperties operation, and a format painter click covers the whole visible word.
reason: The change uses existing shared run-property operations and adds no field. Two mounted editors cover a word format crossing peer typing inside the word, undo, redo, tracked format changes, deletion of the word during the format, convergence, and save/reopen.
